about.hero.title: Who are we?
about.hero.sub: An approved Burundian association dedicated to empowering young people and vulnerable women through sustainable agro-pastoral development.
about.presentation.label: About us
about.presentation.one: The Initiative for the Socio-economic Self-promotion of Youth in Burundi (IPJBU – DUHINDURINGENDO) is a Burundian civil society organisation working in the agro-pastoral sector.
about.presentation.two: It prioritises young people, orphans and vulnerable women, providing training, equipment and guidance to help them build lasting independence.
about.presentation.three: It also serves as a point of contact between local government and the Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock.

prog.objectives.1.title: Training in agro-pastoral techniques
prog.objectives.1.desc: Train young people and vulnerable women in modern agro-pastoral techniques to improve productivity and support sustainable livelihoods.
prog.objectives.2.title: National and international experience exchanges
prog.objectives.2.desc: Organise exchanges at national and international levels to share good agro-pastoral practices and strengthen links between sector stakeholders.
prog.objectives.3.title: Capacity building and equipment
prog.objectives.3.desc: Build stock-management skills and provide beneficiaries with agro-pastoral equipment suited to their needs and local context.
prog.objectives.4.title: Agri-food processing micro-units
prog.objectives.4.desc: Set up small-scale food-processing units to add value to local produce, reduce post-harvest losses and create economic opportunities.
prog.objectives.5.title: Promoting new agro-pastoral technologies
prog.objectives.5.desc: Promote new agro-pastoral technologies across the country to modernise practices and improve yields.
prog.steps.5: Distributing selected seeds and quality livestock and poultry
prog.steps.7: Introducing storage construction and harvest preservation
prog.steps.8: Using a snowball approach to extend coverage across the country
prog.steps.10: Identifying reliable sources of quality seeds and livestock
